name: lru_ttl_cache
description: LRU cache with TTL expiration per entry and max capacity eviction. Expired entries must return None and be lazily or eagerly purged.

requirements.description: Get and set key-value pairs within capacity limit.
Evict least recently used key when capacity is exceeded.
examples: cap=2: set a, set b, get a, set c -> b evicted

requirements.description: Entries must expire after specified TTL seconds.
examples: set('a', 1, ttl=0.1), sleep 0.2 -> get('a') returns None
edge_cases: expired entry does not block capacity
